messages:
Lia Chen (CSM): Quick pulse on Corvara preview cohort — sending a seat ops snapshot. 8 invites sent (2 accepted, 1 declined, 5 pending). Two pending are SSO-blocked and one needs an infra whitelist. Need nudges + a short enablement to collect initial feedback.

Anya Patel (C-S): Got it. Drop the list and mark which are SSO-blocked vs missing product access. I can escalate any SSO blocks to solutions.

Lia Chen (CSM): ```
corvara_seats.csv
- alice@corvara.com, Pending, SSO-blocked
- bob@corvara.com, Accepted, product-access
- dana@corvara.com, Declined, N/A
- emmanuel@corvara.com, Pending, needs infra whitelist
- farah@corvara.com, Pending, SSO-blocked
- gonzalo@corvara.com, Accepted, product-access
- helen@corvara.com, Pending, onboarding docs not acked
- ian@corvara.com, Pending, product-access (reported bug)
```

Mike O'Neill (Onboarding): I can take the SSO follow-ups (alice, farah). @Sam Li can you confirm if our SAML metadata URL or certs changed in prod? Last auth deploy was yesterday.

Sam Li (Eng): No metadata URL change in prod, but we rotated the dev certs yesterday. Try clearing the SP metadata cache and re-trigger the SSO login. If still failing, paste the IdP error. Quick shell snippet to clear cache: `curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.internal/cache/clear -H 'x-service: seat-ops'`

Lia Chen (CSM): Also note — Corvara PM flagged pricing concerns during their trial call. Would like to capture sentiment in the feedback rollup so AE + RevOps can sync. Short feedback form (one-click): https://redwood.app/feedback-form/preview

Anya Patel (C-S): We'll tag that as `renewal_risk:pricing`. @Lia can you propose enablement slots? I can join to answer product questions.

Lia Chen (CSM): Proposed slots: Thu 10:00am PT or Fri 11:00am PT. Prefer Thu. I'll tentatively book Thu 10 and loop in Corvara contacts; will cancel if they pick Fri.

enroll-bot: Enrollment reminder — 3 days left to accept preview seat. Auto-nudge scheduled for pending emails at 1765526276.

Mike O'Neill (Onboarding): Sending targeted SSO checklist to their infra lead now. Checklist snippet to paste: `authn-issuer: https://sso.corvara.com`, `acs: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs`, ensure entityID matches our SP config.

Sam Li (Eng): If we can't reach infra by EOD Tue, propose provisioning short-lived temp tokens for the two blocked seats so we can get feedback. Ops policy: DM me + cc security (will require manual approval).

Lia Chen (CSM): Sounds good. I'll update the cohort sheet, tag owners (Mike for SSO, Sam for temp access if needed, Anya for pricing tag), and send the calendar invite once Corvara confirms. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Anya Patel (C-S): Thanks — once we have the session, capture 3 top asks and any blocker for rollout. I'll feed those into the preview feedback board.

Mike O'Neill (Onboarding): Noted. Will message alice/farah and paste status here after outreach.

Sam Li (Eng): I'll stand by for logs if they hit an error.

Lia Chen (CSM): Closing loop for now — will update thread after invites go out.
